prohibited_zone_types: whole-home short-term rentals (less than 30 days) are prohibited
regulations.enforcement_body: City of Lakewood City Clerk's Office
regulations.notes: Lakewood bans whole-home STRs for stays under 30 days. Owner-occupied hosted stays (where the owner is present) ARE allowed with an STR license. A license and transient occupancy tax registration are required. Rules took effect September 1, 2023. A 2024 review of the ordinance was planned. Verify current fee schedule with the City.
